author: Chris Schommer
title: Colt Keith scratched from lineup Tuesday
desc: Colt Keith has been scratched from the lineup for the Detroit Tigers due to right wrist soreness according to Chris McCosky.
impact: Kerry Carpenter will move into the designated hitter role and bat third while Wenceel Perez takes Carpenter's spot in right field while batting sixth for manager AJ Hinch against the Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.P. Crawford to start at third base Tuesday
desc: J.P. Crawford is getting the start at third base on Tuesday.
impact: Crawford was taking reps at third base prior to landing on the injured list. Colt Emerson will remain at shortstop.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Verlander (hip) to return and start Sunday
desc: Justin Verlander will start on Sunday against the White Sox.
impact: Verlander was able to throw a successful sim game on Monday. His upside will remain limited for fantasy managers early on in his return from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) starting running program
desc: Brendan Donovan is preparing to start a 10-12 day running program.
impact: If all goes well, Donovan will start a rehab assignment in late June or early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marco Gonzales released by Padres
impact: Gonzales posted a 7.99 ERA in 47 1/3 innings in the minor leagues this season. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena (hamstring) considered day-to-day
impact: Arozarena is not in the lineup on Tuesday against the Orioles. He'll be day-to-day heading into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Naylor (wrist) day-to-day
impact: Naylor is not in the lineup on Tuesday against the Orioles. He'll be day-to-day heading into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andres Munoz (back) expected to be available Tuesday
desc: Andres Munoz is expected to be good to go for Tuesday's series opener against the Orioles.
impact: Munoz left Sunday's game early with a back injury. He'll be good to go on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Palencia (elbow) not expected to require MRI
desc: Daniel Palencia is not expected to require an MRI.
impact: Palencia landed back on the injured list on Tuesday. He is without a clear timetable to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: Santiago Espinal designated for assignment
desc: Santiago Espinal was designated for assignment on Tuesday.
impact: Espinal had been filling a utility role for the Dodgers, batting .268 with one homer over 60 plate appearances while appearing at first, second, and third base this season. With Tommy Edman (ankle) rejoining the Dodgers ahead of Tuesday's game, Espinal was the odd man out.

author: Nate Miller
title: Tommy Edman (ankle) activated Tuesday
desc: Tommy Edman (ankle) was activated from the IL ahead of Tuesday's game against the Rays.
impact: Edman has been out all season to this point after having ankle surgery this past November, but the versatile veteran will return to make his 2026 debut for the Dodgers on Tuesday. Santiago Espinal has been designated for assignment to make room on the roster.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Tucker drives in three as Dodgers edge Rays 4-3
desc: Kyle Tucker went 2-for-4 in a win over the Rays with a home run, one run scored, three RBI and one strikeout.
impact: After Monday's win over Tampa Bay, Tucker is now batting .239 with six home runs, 39 RBI, 43 runs scored and six stolen bases across 69 games. He's up to 10 RBI over his last eight games, but still only batting .233 with one homer over that span.

author: Chase Davis
title: Miguel Rojas goes deep off bench for win
desc: Miguel Rojas went 1-for-1 in a win over the Rays with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: Rojas came in off the bench to hit the go-ahead and game-winning solo home run. It's just his second homer of the season as he continues to play in a platoon role. He's started only four of his team's 14 games in June.

author: Nate Miller
title: Seth Lugo (concussion) on track to start Friday
desc: Seth Lugo (concussion) is set to return to the Royals' rotation for Friday's matchup against the Cardinals.
impact: Lugo has been on the 7-day concussion IL since being struck by a line drive in his start back on June 10. The righty has continued throwing, however, and he is expected to return to the mound on Friday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Tanner Scott slams door for save in 4-3 win
desc: Tanner Scott struck out one batter in a scoreless appearance to earn the save in Monday's 4-3 win over the Rays.
impact: After Monday's win, Scott now has a 2.40 ERA and 0.73 WHIP with eight saves, one blown save and five holds across 32 appearances. He hasn't allowed a base runner in either of his last two appearances while picking up a pair of saves. He's just behind Pete Fairbanks for 18th in saves.
